text: Modern GUIs often have a hierarchical structure, i.e., the z-axis of the GUI interaction space. However, conventional mice do not support effective navigation along the z-axis, leading to increased physical movements and cognitive load. To address this inefciency, we present the OtMouse, a novel mouse that supports fnger-lifting operations by detecting fnger height through proximity sensors embedded beneath the mouse buttons, and ‘Over the Mouse’ (OtM) interface, a set of interaction techniques along the z-axis of the GUI interaction space with the OtMouse. Initially, We evaluated the performance of fnger-lifting operations (n = 8) with the OtMouse for two-and three-level lifting discrimination tasks.
